key_insight: OncoSynth is a causally aware synthetic data generator that preserves treatment-outcome relationships well enough to improve treatment effect estimation in oncology.
clinical_relevance: It could help researchers analyze treatment effectiveness and support precision oncology when patient-level data cannot be shared.
method: Uses a diffusion-based sequential generative model.
Models how covariates influence treatment assignment and how treatment affects survival.
Generates synthetic cohorts for both population- and patient-level treatment effect estimation.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on large lung (N=37,128) and breast cancer (N=17,046) cohorts, with treatment effect error reduced by up to 66% at the population level and 58% at the patient level.
watch_item: Synthetic data quality and causal validity may still depend on how well the method generalizes across cancer types, datasets, and unmeasured confounding.
paper_title: OncoSynth: Synthetic data generation for treatment effect estimation in oncology
